description: Join a channel such as "#deploys" so messages other sessions post to it reach you. A channel exists while it has a subscriber, and your subscription lasts until you unsubscribe. Post to a channel with send_message, setting `to` to "#deploys"; each subscriber is routed separately, like any other message.

channel.description: Channel name such as "#deploys": up to 48 lower-case letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores

name: subscribe
title: Subscribe to a channel
